desc_zh: 适用于活动、零售及室内展示的 X 型展示架，可按需求单独或成套供应。
desc_en: Portable X-banner display systems for events, retail and indoor promotions, available separately or as a set.

detail_zh.lead: X 展架采用交叉支撑结构承托展示画面，适合轻便、临时或移动式的室内宣传布置。可根据需要选择展示架硬件、单独印刷画面或成套供应。
highlights: 可单独供应展示架硬件
可单独制作替换印刷画面
具体尺寸、结构和配件按选定款式确认
applications: 会议、培训及临时信息展示
delivery: 硬件与画面可按订单分别包装
成套订单按确认的配置交付
包装及运输根据订单数量和目的地核算
detail_zh.artwork: 请按确认的画面成品尺寸提供文件，并预留必要的安装区域。基础文件检查和简单调整可协助处理，复杂修改或原创设计另行确认。
detail_zh.brief: 请提供使用场景、数量、画面成品尺寸、是否需要支架及配套画面、参考款式、设计文件和交付目的地。
detail_zh.caveat: 不同 X 展架款式的支撑结构、挂点、画面尺寸及配件可能不同。生产前需确认画面与所选支架匹配，不同款式之间不可默认通用。

detail_en.lead: An X-banner stand uses crossed support arms to hold a display graphic. It is a portable option for temporary or mobile indoor promotions. Hardware, a separately printed graphic, or a complete set can be supplied.
highlights: Stand hardware can be supplied separately
Replacement printed graphics can be produced separately
Exact dimensions, construction and accessories depend on the selected model
applications: Meetings, training and temporary information displays
finishing: Hardware and graphic supplied as a set
delivery: Hardware and graphics may be packed separately by order
Complete orders follow the confirmed configuration
Packing and freight are assessed by quantity and destination
detail_en.artwork: Please prepare artwork to the confirmed finished graphic size and allow for the required attachment areas. Basic file checks and minor adjustments can be assisted; extensive changes or original design are confirmed separately.
detail_en.brief: Please share the intended use, quantity, finished graphic size, whether you need the stand and graphic, a reference model, artwork and destination.
detail_en.caveat: Support structure, attachment points, graphic dimensions and accessories may vary between X-banner models. Confirm graphic compatibility with the selected stand before production; interchangeability is not assumed.
